page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a distinct performance profile characterized by moderate multi-core capabilities alongside weaker single-core execution. In single-core evaluations, such as the stress-ng single-core CPU test and Geekbench single-core score, the instance performs in the bottom 25% tier. Single-threaded tasks like gzip compression fall into the bottom 10% tier. Conversely, multi-threaded workloads demonstrate average performance, with the stress-ng multi-core test, Geekbench multi-core score, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression all placing in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the average tier, reaching 98.48 GB/sec for large block read-only operations and 49.01 GB/sec for large block write operations.

Given the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is suited for multi-threaded general-purpose workloads that can distribute execution across its 32 cores. Factual performance metrics indicate average capability for database operations, static web serving, and software compilation. However, the weak single-core performance suggests it is less efficient for highly sequential, single-threaded processing. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated resource allocation and average multi-core density offer a balanced option for legacy enterprise applications, web serving, and moderate database hosting where extreme single-thread speed is not a primary requirement.
